show.description: Cricket Samraat is an inspirational underdog sports drama set in Mumbai’s chawls, where a forgotten gully cricketer rises against power, privilege, and corruption. Forced to play dhol for survival, Viraj challenges an elite system to protect his chawl, his people, and their dignity. The series celebrates resilience, unity, friendship and the belief that true champions are forged through struggle, not privilege. Watch now!
